lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Good evening. Welcome. How may I help you?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: We'd like a table for two, please.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Of course. What would you like to drink?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Could we have two house lemonades, please?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I'll have the pasta primavera, and my friend will have the same.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Would you like to add garlic bread or dessert?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Garlic bread, please, but no dessert for us.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Certainly. I'll bring your order shortly.
